description: This Java test source file is part of the integration tests for the Apache Fineract project. It contains tests verifying the structure of responses from manual interest refund transactions on loans, including responses with and without external IDs. The tests create loans, make refunds, and assert the correctness of the response fields related to interest refunds.

classes.name: LoanManualInterestRefundResponseStructureTest
classes.description: JUnit test class verifying the structure of responses from manual interest refund API calls in loan transactions.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes test setup, REST assured, request/response specifications, helper classes, and creates a default client.

methods.name: testManualInterestRefundResponseStructureWithoutExternalIds
methods.description: Tests the response structure of a manual interest refund transaction when no external IDs are provided, verifying the correctness of transaction fields.

methods.name: testManualInterestRefundResponseStructureWithExternalIds
methods.description: Tests the response structure of a manual interest refund transaction when external IDs are provided, verifying correct mapping and null fields.

methods.name: createManualInterestRefund
methods.description: Helper method to create a manual interest refund transaction, optionally with an external ID.

methods.name: makeLoanMerchantIssuedRefund
methods.description: Helper method to make a merchant-issued loan refund without automatic interest refund.

methods.name: makeLoanMerchantIssuedRefundWithExternalId
methods.description: Helper method to make a merchant-issued loan refund with an external ID.

methods.name: findTransactionByType
methods.description: Utility to find a specific transaction by type from loan transaction details.

methods.name: applyAndApproveProgressiveLoanWithExternalId
methods.description: Creates, applies, and approves a progressive loan with an external ID.
